001.method: Inspected all fourteen final normalized seated-contact-grid-2x.png files with view_image at original detail. Independently placed each integer Y line beneath the pelvis/upper thigh in S/E/W/N, rather than at the inferred waist/hand line. For coats, used the projected pelvis and thigh contact rather than the coat hem. Bound all 56 contacts to the exact final native source hashes; reviewed preserved cyan overlays and approved south-chair composites after rebuilding. Other chair orientations are not claimed.
